title: Hall-O-Weekend
long_description:
Join the Downtown Milford Business Association (DMBA) for our annual Hall-O-Weekend celebration. Make memories and enjoy some no-so-scary fun in our charming downtown. 

Our Hall-🎃-Weekend starts Friday!! We want to give an extra big THANK YOU to:

Hall-🎃-Weekend Presenting Sponsor: 

Screen presented by: @bigscreens

Weekend Schedule:

🎥 🧙Friday 23th 6:00 Hocus Pocus @ the gazebo on the Green. Snack boxes available on @scratchbakingct website for pre-order 

🏅Saturday, October 24th: 13th Annual "Trick or Trot" to support Beth El Center's Shelter and Food program. 

register here at: www.bethelmilford.com

AND…

🧙Saturday 24th 10-3pm Fall Fest on the Green. 

At the Gazebo:

10am Not-so-Scary Storytime

11am Spooky Children’s yoga with @justbe

12pm School of Rock

1pm GCA of Milford ninja showcase and cheer showcase 

11-2pm Trick or Treat trail (throughout downtown & the Green)

Costume parade,vendors, yoga, pumpkin patch, children’s activities,hay maze and trick-or-treating. Fun for the whole family!
